theorem sum_R2L {α x δ Q : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hx : 1 < x) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hcop : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ)) (h2α : 2 * α = a / q + δ / x + k) (hqQ : (q : ℝ) ≤ Q)
    (hδ : |δ / x| * (q * Q) ≤ 1) {D' : ℝ} (hD'q : (q : ℝ) / 2 < D') (hD'Q : D' ≤ Q / 2)
    (hD'c : D' ≤ c₂ * x / q) (hD'4 : D' ≤ x / 4) (hD'e : D' ≤ x / rexp 1) :
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊(q : ℝ) / 2⌋ ⌊D'⌋, (if (q : ℤ) ∣ n then 0 else TLn α x n) ≤
      5 * c₀ * c₂ / (3 * π ^ 2) * (D' * Real.log (rexp (1 / 2) * x / D') +
        4 * √(2 * c₂ * x) * Real.log (2 * rexp 1 * x / c₂)) :=

note: Lean route: blocks via sum_Ioc_le_blocks and Lemma 4.1.2 (lines 488–555), S2_le (line 560), then s(½+log q−log s) ≤ c₂(1+log q−log c₂) (hsΛ, line 577), so log(2x/q)+log(eq/c₂) = log(2ex/c₂). The repo's 'only justified for q ≥ 2' (bound_4_41 docstring) is the monotonicity condition q e^{−1/2} ≥ c₂; at q = 1 there is nothing to prove.
